premises.text: The Bright Context platform provides a cloud-based solution for real-time data stream processing.
premises.evidence_span: we provide a cloud-based platform for software developers that makes it easy to do two key things, to take large streams of data that are in flight real-time and to process them.

premises.text: Real-time data processing can enhance audience engagement during live events.
premises.evidence_span: the result is a whole new dimension to television, giving you an unprecedented insight into the sentiment of the audience in real time.

premises.text: TV audiences can be extremely large, creating a significant data processing challenge.
premises.evidence_span: a debate can draw about 60 stadiums of people watching at the same time.

premises.text: The platform allows developers to easily integrate real-time data processing into their applications.
premises.evidence_span: you've offloaded a huge amount of complexity to us in terms of scaling and back end, and you freed yourself up to create amazing front end experiences in the tools of your choice.

premises.text: The platform combines data stream processing and data broadcasting in one solution.
premises.evidence_span: we provide both data stream processing as well as data broadcast and push in one package.

premises.text: Real-time data processing is a major trend that will define the next chapter of the internet.
premises.evidence_span: Real time is a major trend already. In the next chapter of the internet, it will be a defining trend.

value.text: Developers can create innovative applications powered by real-time data processing.
value.evidence_span: we're here to empower you to disrupt and innovate around real time.
